signal.action: Enter long position on a pullback to the $1,080-$1,100 support zone

summary.executive_summary: NVDA continues to demonstrate strong momentum driven by AI infrastructure demand. Technical setup is constructive with the stock consolidating above its 50-day moving average. Near-term catalysts include the upcoming GTC developer conference and strong forward guidance from cloud hyperscalers.
summary.investment_thesis: Sustained AI training and inference spend by hyperscalers positions NVDA for continued earnings outperformance. The H200 and Blackwell GPU ramps are tracking ahead of consensus estimates, supporting a premium valuation multiple.
summary.key_risk: Any slowdown in hyperscaler capex commitments or an export restriction expansion to additional GPU configurations could materially compress the near-term revenue outlook.
